title: Conformally Calibrated Adaptive Computation in Neural Operators
abstract: arXiv:2611.23440v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Selecting less computation in a neural operator need not reduce inference time. We study this gap using conformal calibration to choose Fourier modes or channel width per input subject to a fixed error budget. A triangle-inequality envelope bounds all candidates simultaneously; a direct-score rule handles non-monotone candidate errors and, with an input-independent score, calibrates a static baseline under the same marginal guarantee. Under frozen-model and exchangeability assumptions, both rules bound the probability of issuing a prediction outside the budget and abstain when calibration is infeasible. On Burgers and Darcy flow across three training seeds, mode selection reduces active spectral support without a measurable latency reduction, because full-grid transforms and channel mixing dominate the cost. translated_title: 神经算子中经保形校准的自适应计算
translated_abstract: arXiv:2611.23440v1 公告类型：新论文 摘要：在神经算子中选择更少的计算量并不必然缩短推理时间。我们利用保形校准来研究这一差距，在固定误差预算的约束下，针对每个输入自适应地选择傅里叶模态数或通道宽度。三角不等式包络可同时界定所有候选配置；直接评分规则可处理候选误差非单调的情形，并且在评分与输入无关时，能够在相同的边际保证下校准一个静态基线。在模型冻结与可交换性假设下，两种规则都能保证发出超出预算预测的概率有界，并在校准不可行时选择弃权。在Burgers方程和Darcy流动问题上、跨越三个训练种子的实验中，模态选择虽然减少了活跃谱支持范围，但并未带来可测量的延迟降低，原因在于全网格变换和通道混合主导了计算成本。缩小通道宽度确实降低了Darcy正问题的计算成本，但基于参考的选择必须先计算稠密预测。一个输入……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出一种基于保形校准的自适应计算方法，在固定误差预算下为每个输入选择神经算子的傅里叶模态数或通道宽度并提供统计保证，同时发现模态选择虽缩减了谱支持范围，却因全网格变换主导计算成本而几乎无法降低推理延迟。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes conformally calibrated adaptive computation for neural operators—per-input selection of Fourier modes or channel width under a fixed error budget with statistical guarantees—and shows that mode selection reduces spectral support but yields no measurable latency reduction because full-grid transforms dominate the cost.
